## Load Libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
library("cowplot")

```

## Load data

## 2D data representation in PC coordinates

```{r}
# Extract explained variance for PC1 and PC2
explained_var <- pca_fit |> 
  tidy(matrix = "eigenvalues") |> 
  select(1, 2) |> 
  pluck(percent)

# 2D scatter plot of data projected onto the two major principle components
pca_fit |> 
  augment(biopsy) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = .fittedPC1,
             y = .fittedPC2,
             color = outcome,
             shape = outcome)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5,
             alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "PC1",
       y = "PC2",
       title = "Breast cancer biopsy data projected on PCs")
  
```
